newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN P-NOTES - Tenders total A$40.0 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN P-NOTES - Tenders total A$40.0 mln.

text.p: Listed property fund General Property Trust held the first Australian promissory note tender of the year on Thursday, selling a total of A$40.0 million.
The issue went roughly four basis points over BBSW.
Dealers said the discount securities market remained captive to traditional holiday season torpor with the physical bank bill yield curve having strengthened slightly since last trading on Tuesday.
At 0015 GMT (11.15 a.m.) March bill futures were trading two points lower at 94.14.
